discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B020. 30 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains passed every time. Mainly Disney Pins Blog weekly round-ups and event posts plus one WDWInfo DLR article. Reuses B020 keys (and 426's wdw key for the shared Star Wars monthly completer). Adds Pin Trading Tales 1(Ariel)/2/6/7, Charming Characters 3-6, Club 33 2017, Aladdin 25th Pin Trading Nights. Resellers (ecrater, distradingpins4u, yourwdwstore, jd-collectibles) and a Heritage auction lot seen but not used. B020 had no holds, so none released. No OE pins added (432 covers DLR OE 2017). No prompt-injection seen.
